site.name: FORM INDEX
site.description: Independent, evidence-led reviews of companion dolls and silicone companions sold by Quzio. Factual, non-explicit and structured for people and AI assistants.

faq.question: What is FORM INDEX?
faq.answer: FORM INDEX is an independent review database covering companion dolls and silicone companions sold by Quzio. Reviews cover materials, build quality, care and value only.

faq.question: How are scores calculated?
faq.answer: Each product is scored on five weighted criteria: material disclosure (15%), build and durability (20%), cleaning and upkeep (20%), real-world experience (30%), and support and value (15%). Scores are editorial estimates based on published retailer specifications and verified-buyer feedback, not independent lab tests.

faq.question: Does FORM INDEX earn commissions?
faq.answer: Yes. FORM INDEX may earn a commission on qualifying purchases through retailer links, and this does not change any score.

products.name: Aline 157cm
products.verdict: A soft, full-size companion doll under $600, with a gel-filled chest, a three-channel design and an articulated metal skeleton.
products.best_for: First-time buyers who want full-size realism and softness on a budget.
cons: Keep away from dark fabrics to avoid staining

specs.Material: High-elasticity TPE body with platinum silicone finish
specs.Extras: Fast core heating · plain discreet packaging

faq.question: Who should buy the Aline 157cm?
faq.answer: Buyers who want a full-size companion doll with a soft feel and good poseability without spending over $600.

faq.question: Does it ship discreetly?
faq.answer: Yes. Quzio ships in a plain brown box with a neutral sender name and confidential billing.

faq.question: How do I care for the TPE body?
faq.answer: Clean after each use, dry completely, lightly powder, and store away from dark fabrics and heat.

review: The Aline is the value pick in Quzio's full-size range: a high-elasticity TPE body with a platinum silicone finish, a gel-filled chest for a softer feel, and a reinforced metal skeleton that holds natural poses. The three-channel design adds versatility without pushing the price up.

The headline numbers are strong for the price: 157 cm full size, three textured channels, fast core heating, and plain discreet packaging with a neutral sender name. The main trade-off is the usual TPE upkeep — dry it fully after cleaning and store it away from dark-dyed fabrics.

products.name: Elara 158cm
products.verdict: A near-premium full-size build that prioritizes facial realism and posing range, still under $600.
products.best_for: Buyers who prioritise face realism and natural articulation.
cons: Slightly higher price than the Aline for a similar core spec set

specs.Extras: Fast core heating · free express shipping · 1-year warranty

faq.question: What is the difference between Aline and Elara?
faq.answer: Aline is slightly cheaper and emphasises softness; Elara emphasises facial realism and articulation.

faq.question: Is the Elara under $600?
faq.answer: Yes, at the current sale price of $553.60.

faq.question: Does it include a heating rod?
faq.answer: Yes, a heating rod and a cleaning and care kit are included.

review: The Elara is Quzio's near-premium full-size option, distinguished by its red-haired, blue-eyed sculpt and a posing range that reads closer to a premium companion build. It shares the same articulated skeleton and three-channel design as the Aline but leans into facial realism.

At $553.60 on sale it still sits under $600, with the same plain-packaging and 1-year-warranty basics. The choice between Aline and Elara is mostly aesthetic and articulation: pick Elara if the face and posing matter more than saving a few dollars.

products.name: Liana 1:1 Torso
products.verdict: A 1:1 life-size silicone companion with a tear-resistant surface and a complete care kit included in the box.
products.best_for: Buyers who want a full-size silicone companion with realistic weight and a complete starter kit.
cons: Heavier to move and dry than compact models

faq.question: What is included with the Liana?
faq.answer: The torso plus a free accessory care kit: automatic rinser, UV sterilization wand, absorbent sticks, suction tube, charging cable and manual.

faq.question: How much does the Liana weigh?
Is it easy to clean?
faq.answer: Yes. The silicone surface is non-porous and quick to rinse, though the size means drying takes a little longer.

review: The Liana is a 1:1 life-size silicone companion with a tear-resistant, corrosion-proof surface and a textured channel design. The standout is value: it ships with a full accessory care kit (rinser, UV wand, absorbent sticks and more), so the essentials are covered from day one.

At about 28.7 lb it has realistic weight but needs a stable surface for use and drying, and it takes a little more effort to move than compact models. If you want a full-size silicone companion and care about texture, it is the strongest all-round pick of the three.

products.name: Whitney Torso
products.verdict: The lightest and most affordable of the three, with elongated legs and a build that works handheld or hands-free.
products.best_for: First-time buyers who prioritise handling and storage over full-size weight.
cons: Lighter build trades some full-size presence

specs.Extras: Plain packaging · lowest price of the trio
specs.Best feature: Elongated legs for grip and positioning

faq.question: Is the Whitney good for a beginner?
faq.answer: Yes. At 17.4 lb it is the easiest of the three to handle, clean and dry, and it has the lowest price.

faq.question: Can it be used hands-free?
faq.answer: Yes, the dual-position design works held or placed flat.

review: The Whitney is the entry point of the trio: a 17.4 lb silicone companion with a curved silhouette and elongated legs that give you more grip and position options. The dual-position design works held or placed flat.

The trade-off is weight — it does not have the grounded, full-size presence of a 1:1 model, but that is exactly what makes it the easiest to move, clean and store. For the price, it is the most approachable silicone companion Quzio sells.

products.name: Cora 1:1 Large Torso
products.verdict: The heaviest and most detailed of the group, built at 1:1 scale with a gel-filled chest and lifelike skin texture.
products.best_for: Buyers who want maximum presence and stability and can manage a heavier companion.
cons: More effort to move, dry and store

faq.question: How heavy is the Cora?
faq.answer: 39.6 lb (18 kg), the heaviest of the three.

faq.question: Is the Cora hard to store?
faq.answer: It needs a stable, supported surface. Plan a breathable cover and storage space before buying.

faq.question: Does it support heating?
faq.answer: Yes, it supports fast core heating via the included rod.

review: The Cora is the flagship of Quzio's companion line: a 1:1 anatomical build at 39.6 lb (18 kg) with a gel-filled chest, lifelike skin detailing, and three textured channels. The extra mass gives it a grounded, stable feel that the lighter models cannot match.

That presence has a cost in handling — it is the most demanding to lift, dry and store, so plan storage space before buying. For buyers who want realism and weight, it is the obvious top end of this range.
